manifest.name: Tasks & habits
manifest.plain: A to-do list and habit tracker you fill in. It works only when you open it, keeps everything on this phone and never goes online.
manifest.description: A to-do list with Today / Upcoming / Done, swipe to delete and an add sheet, plus a Habits tab with daily streaks and counters. Fits: chores, errands, checklists, packing lists, habits.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

profile_name.desc: a first name or a household name

notes_for_juli: Pick a short title (1-2 words). lists = 1-4 groups that fit the request, each with its own colour. tasks = 3-8 concrete starter tasks that match the request, each in one of the list names, due in days from today (0 = today). Use habits only when the person asks for habits or routines, otherwise an empty list. suggestions = 3 one-tap task titles. profile_name: "Me" unless the person names who it is for. Example for "errands": {"title": "Errands", "accent": "#2f6bff", "lists": [{"name": "Home", "color": "#ff9f0a"}, {"name": "Shop", "color": "#34c759"}], "tasks": [{"title": "Buy milk", "list": "Shop", "due": 0, "prio": 1}, {"title": "Fix the gate", "list": "Home", "due": 2, "prio": 2}, {"title": "Return library books", "list": "Home", "due": -1, "prio": 3}], "habits_title": "Habits", "habits": [{"name": "Drink water", "icon": "drop", "color": "#32ade6", "goal": 8, "unit": "glasses"}, {"name": "Walk", "icon": "leaf", "color": "#34c759", "goal": 1}], "suggestions": ["Water plants", "Pay rent", "Call mum"], "profile_name": "Sam"}
